article_title: Airport drop-off charges to be reviewed after sharp increase

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: The government plans to close several UK airports.
The government will review airport drop-off fees after large price rises and concerns about fairness.
All European airports have introduced identical parking charges.
UK airports have agreed to make every drop-off zone free.
tasks.correct_answer: The government will review airport drop-off fees after large price rises and concerns about fairness.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בהחלטת הממשלה לבדוק את דמי ההורדה בנמלי התעופה לאחר עליות חדות וחששות בנוגע להוגנות.

tasks.prompt: How much do Gatwick and Stansted now charge for drop-off?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, גטוויק וסטנסטד העלו את דמי ההורדה מ־7 ליש״ט ל־10 ליש״ט.

tasks.prompt: What does “exercise restraint” mean in the government's request to airports?
options: Stop allowing cars at terminals
Avoid making excessive price increases
Charge every passenger the same airfare
Replace drop-off zones with train stations
tasks.explanation_hebrew: exercise restraint פירושו לנהוג באיפוק ולהימנע מעליות מחיר מוגזמות, במיוחד כשאין חלופות טובות.

tasks.prompt: Which airport was most expensive on a per-minute basis in the RAC analysis?
options: Belfast International
Edinburgh
Gatwick
London City
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לונדון סיטי גבתה 8 ליש״ט לחמש דקות, כלומר 1.60 ליש״ט לדקה — השיעור הגבוה ביותר לדקה.

tasks.prompt: Why does the government particularly mention airports with limited public transport alternatives?
options: Travellers there may have little practical choice except being dropped off by car.
Those airports are all publicly owned.
Public transport is always more expensive than flying.
They have already removed every drop-off charge.
tasks.correct_answer: Travellers there may have little practical choice except being dropped off by car.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר התחבורה הציבורית מוגבלת, לנוסעים יש פחות אפשרויות ולכן העלאת דמי ההורדה מכבידה עליהם במיוחד.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what is a “rip-off”?
options: A price people believe is unfairly high
A free service provided by an airport
A rapid journey through security
A tax paid only by airlines
tasks.correct_answer: A price people believe is unfairly high
tasks.explanation_hebrew: rip-off הוא מחיר או עסקה שנתפסים כיקרים ולא הוגנים; ארבעה מכל חמישה נהגים תיארו כך את העמלות.

tasks.prompt: What reasons do airports and environmental campaigners give for keeping drop-off charges?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שהעמלות מוצגות כחלק מהמודל העסקי, שדות תעופה בריטיים פרטיים ומשלמים מסים, והחיוב עשוי להפחית עומס וזיהום ולעודד תחבורה ירוקה.
expected_points: The airport industry says the fees are a necessary part of its business model.
UK airports are generally privately owned and face commercial taxation.
Charges may encourage travellers to use more environmentally friendly transport.
The fees can help manage traffic congestion and air pollution around terminals.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the arguments for and against airport drop-off charges.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להציג את העליות והכעס הציבורי לצד טענות נמלי התעופה לגבי מימון, ניהול תנועה, זיהום ונקודות הורדה חינמיות.
expected_points: Critics point to sharp increases, high per-minute prices and limited understanding of why the charges exist.
The RAC says major international airports should not charge for dropping off passengers.
Airports say the fees support their privately funded business model and that free alternatives are available.
Supporters argue that charging can reduce congestion, pollution and car use.

tasks.prompt: What information would a fair government review need to compare across airports?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע השוואה של מחיר וזמן, זמינות נקודות חינמיות ותחבורה ציבורית, עלויות תפעול ומסים, והשפעה על נוסעים, עומס וזיהום.
expected_points: Compare the fee, permitted time and penalty rules at each airport.
Check whether free drop-off points and realistic public transport alternatives exist.
Examine airport ownership, taxation and how fee revenue is used.
Assess effects on accessibility, household costs, congestion and air pollution.

tasks.prompt: Write a short neutral notice explaining the planned review to airport passengers.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את העליות האחרונות, מטרת הבדיקה להבטיח נגישות והוגנות, בקשת האיפוק מהממשלה, וקיום טיעונים משני הצדדים.
expected_points: State that the government has committed to reviewing airport drop-off charges.
Mention that average prices at major airports have risen sharply since summer 2025.
Explain that the review will consider accessibility and fair treatment of passengers.
Note that airports have been asked to limit rises, while the industry says charges support operations and traffic management.
